author: Rusty McMurray / Soulshine; built by Claude at his direction
preserves: v1.1-v1.7 (v1.7 receipt ccc40e13...ce90). world.py and v1_readers.py byte-identical to v1. Full-sight world unchanged.
direction: Rusty, 2026-10-15, with commons_swarm_v2 as the model: a discovery calls a DIFFERENT member to the SAME place LATER to confirm with its own eyes; an unconfirmed find lapses. No penalty for past error (same morning).
corrections_to_v1_7: v1.7's homemaker confirmed on OLDER ground (looked backward); the village witness arrives LATER and looks at the same place forward in time.
v1.7 deposited -1 for an unconfirmed find (a record of wrongs); in the village an unconfirmed find simply lapses.

family.SCOUT: unchanged from v1.7: at each need reads the frontier (newest 14 days) against each region's history before the 42-day span; discovery = sign test p < .01 over eligible regions AND pooled frontier z > 2.326. A discovery becomes a PENDING FIND recording its day f, its up-regions, and its baseline (history before f-41). One pending find at a time; discoveries while a find is pending are not new finds.
family.HOMEMAKER_WITNESS: is called to the pending find and arrives at the first need with at least 14 days (one block) of data AFTER the find. It reads the SAME up-regions on days f+1..d only, against the find's own baseline. Confirmed iff the sign test over those regions (eligible) passes p < .01 AND pooled z on that new ground > 2.326. One visit: confirmed, or the find LAPSES.
family.HOUSEKEEPER: keeps the family record. A confirmed find deposits +1. A lapsed find is recorded as knowledge and deposits NOTHING. Only entries within the present 42-day span weigh. The family PROPOSES when the present tally > 0.

ablations.SCOUT_ALONE: every discovery deposits +1 immediately, no witness (as v1.7's ablation).
ablations.LAPSE_PENALTY: v1.8 except a lapsed find deposits -1 (a record of wrongs).

experiments: lambda 32, 128, 8 x 6 families x 300 seeds; probe; BURST b = 5, 8; v1.7, v1.6, v1.2 alongside on identical worlds.

predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.Z2_genuine: GENUINE >= 158 at lambda 32 (v1.6) and >= 240 at lambda 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.Z3_positional_confounds: COMMUTE <= 5 and DINNER <= 5 at lambda 32 and 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.Z4_difficult_month: WINDOW < v1.7's (29 at lambda 32, 109 at lambda 128).
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.Z7_action: macro accuracy > v1.7's (0.8221 at lambda 32, 0.8659 at lambda 128).
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.Z8_information_limit: COLOCATED vs GENUINE |z| < 3 at lambda 32 and 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.Z10_honest_expectation: DESCRIPTIVE, not scored: a 30-day transient whose find is made early in the window can still be confirmed by a witness arriving 14 days later while the transient is still running. Forward witnessing is expected to cut bursts shorter than the witness delay far more than the difficult month.

reporting_rule: PASS/FAIL as frozen with exact counts. No change after the first full run.
